images.caption: Figure 2:Framework Overview.We consider a sparse set of observations capturing an object in different articulation states and from different viewpoints. First, each view is lifted to 3D, resulting in partial point clouds which are encoded and tokenized via a frozen PartField[36]and geometric embeddings. The point tokens and a fixed set of learnable part queries pass through theMulti-state Articulation Transformer, whose layers alternate between state-wise and global attention. Per-query heads decode the joint parameters and a per-point head predicts the movable part segmentation.
Figure 3:Observed articulation span.The target is defined as the range of joint values covered by the input observations, encouraging the model to aggregate articulation cues across multiple states.
